parsed.claim_reason: Counterexample: let A_i = {x, y_i, z_1,...,z_{i-1}} for i≥1. All A_i share x, so the family is pairwise intersecting. Yet for each k≥1, T_k = {y_1,...,y_k, z_k} is an inclusion-minimal transversal (hits A_i via y_i if i≤k, via z_k if i>k), so there are infinitely many.
parsed.witness_reason: The family of singletons {x_n} with distinct x_n is pairwise disjoint, not pairwise intersecting; it violates the hypothesis, so it cannot refute the claim (even though it does have infinitely many minimal transversals).
